title: Kissed Mediterranean Prawns Salad
description: A briny, crunchy salad featuring seared raw frozen prawns, fresh greens, and a lemon deglaze fond.

ingredients.name: raw frozen prawns, peeled and deveined

instructions: Thaw the prawns in cold water for 10 minutes and pat them dry.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium-high and add 10ml of olive oil, then sear the prawns 30 seconds on each side until just opaque.
Remove the prawns, set aside, and add the remaining oil to the pan with one minced garlic clove, cooking for 15 seconds.
Deglaze the pan with 20ml lemon juice and 10ml white wine, scraping the fond.
Return the prawns to the pan, toss to coat, and remove from heat.
In a large bowl, combine the greens, tomatoes, cucumber, olives, onion, and parsley.
Whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, salt, pepper, and smoked paprika to make the vinaigrette.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad and toss gently.
Top the salad with the seared prawns.
